errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени по размер, като най-големият е "Течни горива", а най-малкият е "Твърди горива".
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the sectors are ordered by size. While it correctly identifies the largest and smallest sectors, the overall arrangement of the slices in the pie chart is not sorted by value. For example, the slice for 36.3% is followed by the slice for 13.3%.
